'''Jay''', also identified by the [[clone trooper/Legends|clone trooper]] number '''RC-1135''', was a [[Gender/Legends|male]] [[Cloning/Legends|clone]] of the [[Mandalorian/Legends|Mandalorian]] [[Bounty hunter/Legends|bounty hunter]] [[Jango Fett/Legends|Jango Fett]]. Born on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Kamino/Legends|Kamino]], Jay was created by [[Kaminoan/Legends|Kaminoan]] cloners for use in the [[Grand Army of the Republic/Legends|Grand Army]] of the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]]. Trained as a [[Clone commando/Legends|clone commando]], he was a member of [[Theta Squad]], and spent his entire life alongside his squad mates [[Darman Skirata|Darman]], [[Vin (clone commando)|Vin]] and their [[Sergeant/Legends|sergeant]], [[Taler (clone commando)|Taler]]. The squad was deployed on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Geonosis/Legends|Geonosis]] during the [[First Battle of Geonosis/Legends|first battle]] of the [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]] and fought alongside [[Delta Squad/Legends|Delta Squad]], another commando unit, against the forces of the [[Confederacy of Independent Systems/Legends|Confederacy of Independent Systems]]. While fighting in a series of caverns under the planet's surface, Theta provided covering fire for Delta as they progressed through a breached [[Blast door/Legends|blast door]]. [[Geonosian/Legends|Geonosian]] warriors then overwhelmed Jay, Vin and Taler; however, and [[Death/Legends|killed]] them, leaving Darmen as the sole survivor of Theta.<ref name="RC:HC" /> Like all clone troopers, Jay was 1.83 [[Meter/Legends|meters]] tall.<ref name="db" />

==Behind the scenes==
RC-1135 first appeared in ''[[Republic Commando: Hard Contact]]'' a novel written by [[Karen Traviss]] and released in [[2004]]. He later received mention in other books in the [[Republic Commando|''Republic Commando'' series]].
